event_id.description: Unique identifier for the Snowplow event. Suggested ClickHouse column: String. A natural primary/dedup key.

event_name.description: Name of the Snowplow event. Suggested column: String.

app_id.description: Application identifier the event was tracked from. Suggested column: String.

user_id.description: Business/user-supplied user identifier. Suggested column: String.

collector_tstamp.description: Timestamp the event was received by the collector, ISO 8601. Parsed via date_time_input_format=best_effort. Suggested column: DateTime64(3).

web_page_id.description: Page view identifier from the Snowplow web_page context. Suggested column: String. Optional chaining yields an omitted key when the context is absent.

domain_userid.description: First-party cookie identifier for the user's device. Suggested column: String.

domain_sessionid.description: First-party cookie identifier for the user's session. Suggested column: String.
